findings.title: Require typed configuration-to-result context equality explicitly
findings.trigger: A different ConfigSpec.identity (or session/availability) is supplied with its actual new content fingerprint, while result.metadata keeps its old config_digest/context. Reissue the receipt through make_receipt using the new fingerprint. The specified make_receipt/equality sequence accepts these declarations.
findings.consequence: The explanation can expose result cutoffs/config identity as receipt-bound alongside a different supplied configuration, despite promising complete actual config/result binding. Content fingerprints alone do not connect those semantic facts.
findings.requested_change: Before constructing an explanation, require result.metadata.namespace/session_id/availability/config_digest equal configuration.session.namespace/session_id/availability/digest; require focused entity session match as applicable. Freeze configuration schema/algorithm compatibility too. Use explicit checks equivalent to accepted make_content_receipt context checks while retaining optional unavailable inputs; add independently consistent negative cases with actual updated configuration fingerprints/receipt rather than only stale-hash mutation.

probe.scope: Accepted foundation helpers/fixture only; no explanation runtime exists or was run.

findings.title: Freeze nonempty evidence-reference wire shape before implementation
findings.trigger: The record is EvidenceReference(index,row), but the projection says each index plus all11EvidenceRow fields, without stating whether row fields are nested under row or flattened. The only known-byte oracle has evidence=[], so both incompatible shapes satisfy it.
findings.consequence: An implementer must choose public JSON schema and evidence-null/enum projection behavior after Ready; there is no independent expected wire case proving the retained-reference portion of the promised bounded explanation API.
findings.requested_change: Add an exact EvidenceReference JSON key table (nested row or flattened, including full row keys and enum/null encoding), then independently hand-author at least one nonempty retained/excluded reference canonical oracle before production exists. Include index binding, displayed omission and derived reported_exclusion finding, and bind all receipt/output descriptors. The existing zero-evidence oracle and seven scalar count rows remain useful and should be retained.

corrections: Explicit config.schema1/algorithmv1 plus namespace/session/availability/config_digest and focus session equality before constructing summaries; full supplied actual fingerprints do not replace semantic context checks.
Exact nested EvidenceReference JSON table and independently authored retained/excluded/omitted fixture before runtime.
